Beta release — please send feedback from Help › Send Feedback.

Improvements

  • "While you were away" stands out more. The card now sits in the middle of the window, which dims behind it. Click outside the card to close it.

Bug fixes

  • Long tooltips no longer cover what they describe. They now sit fully above the item.

Beta release — please send feedback from Help › Send Feedback.

What's new

  • While you were away. When you turn off Privacy Mode, a card lists any mail that came in while it was on. Click a conversation to open it.

Bug fixes

  • Buy License works again. The button now opens the checkout page instead of a "page not found" error.

Beta release — please send feedback from Help › Send Feedback.

Improvements

  • New tooltips. Rest on a button and its name now appears in a small dark label above it. The labels show up faster and are shorter.
  • Privacy Mode is smoother. The blur fades in and out, and compose windows no longer jump in size.
  • Move windows in Privacy Mode. Drag anywhere on the blurred window to move it.
